00006 /**
00007  * @brief  This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit extended list
00008  * API.
00009  *
00010  * An extended list is a list where the items can be customized by
00011  * applications.  The items in an extended list can contain multiple strings
00012  * as well as images.  The application is called when each item in the list
00013  * needs to be drawn.
00014  *
00015  * @ingroup HXUI
00016  * @file hxlistextended.h
00017  * <hr>
00018  **/

00084 /**

00087  * HxListExtendedDelete deletes a list created from an earlier call to
00088  * HxListExtendedNew.

00096  *

00103 /**
00104  * @brief               Add an item to a list
00105  *
00106  * HxListExtendedAddItem adds a new item to the list.  Unlike HxListAddItem,
00107  * no string or icon is associated with the new item, since the application
00108  * is responsible for maintaining this information.
00109  *
00110  * The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the
00111  * item should be inserted.  If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater
00112  * than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to
00113  * the list.  The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the
00114  * outgoing pIndex.
00115  *
00116  * @param pList         IN:     Pointer to a list
00117  * @param pIndex        IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
00118  *
00119  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.   Returns
00120  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR is a memory error occurs.
00121  *
00122  **/
00123 HxResult HxListExtendedAddItem(HxListExtended_t* pList, int32_t* pIndex);
00124
